title: Katadyn North America Recalls Optimus Gemini Portable Gas Stoves Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled stove's gas regulator can have a tear in the seal causing a gas leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,100 (In addition, about 500 were sold in Canada).

title: MillerKnoll Recalls Desk and Storage Units Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban; Lead Poisoning Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The surface paint on the tan side panels of the desks and storage units contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 700.

title: Swift Industries Recalls Rubber Straps for Swift Bicycle Bags Due to Crash and Injury Hazard
summary: The rubber straps that fasten the bicycle bag to the bicycle can break causing the bag to come loose and fall, posing crash hazard and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 1,800.

title: Target Recalls Tea Kettles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The paint can chip on the bottom of the recalled kettles, posing a fire hazard. In addition, the handle can break and/or the spout can leak, posing a risk of burn injuries. Units: About 12,800.

title: AQUALUNG Recalls Buoyancy Compensator Devices Due to Injury and Drowning Hazards
summary: The dump valve knob can get stuck when the recalled BCD is inflated, opening the dump valve which stops the BCD from fully inflating. This can result in a loss of buoyancy control and poses injury (decompression sickness) and drowning hazards. Units: 330.

title: Backyard Nature Products Recalls Birds Choice Acrylic Bird Baths Due to Fire Hazard
summary: When sunlight goes through the recalled bird bath's acrylic surfaces onto nearby wooden surfaces, such as siding or decking, the wood surface can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500.

title: Gel Blaster Recalls Gel Blaster SURGE Model 1.0 Toy Guns Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion battery pack inside the handle can overheat and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 62,700.

title: Juvo Plus Recalls Children's Butterfly Net Sets and Army Action Figure Playsets Due to Violations of Federal Phthalates and Lead Content Bans (Recall Alert)
summary: Components of the recalled butterfly net sets and the action figure playsets contain levels of certain phthalates and lead that exceed the federal phthalate and lead content standards. Phthalates and lead are toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 22,50

title: TJX Recalls Baby Blankets Due to Choking, Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The threads in the recalled woven baby blankets can come loose and detach posing choking, entrapment and strangulation hazards. Units: About 108,000 (In addition, about 3,550 were sold in Canada).

title: Bombardier Recreational Products (BRP) Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel injector hose retainer screw can loosen and cause a fuel leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,200 (In addition, about 3,900 were sold in Canada).

title: Children's Sleepwear Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard; Imported by Ekouaer; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com
summary: The children's bathrobes fail to meet the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 9,200.

title: Children's Sleepwear Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard; Imported by Jammers Apparel Group; Sold Exclusively at JCPenney
summary: The children's nightgowns fail to meet the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 450.

title: Cressi-Sub USA Recalls Scuba Diver Buoyancy Compensator Devices Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: Defective metal fittings on the inflator hose can cause an airflow restriction and failure to inflate, or improper inflation of the BCD, posing a drowning hazard to the user. Units: About 1,350.

title: Early Learning Centre Little Senses Lights & Sounds Shape Sorter Toys Due to Choking Hazard; Manufactured by Addo Play; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com
summary: The red cube can come apart or detach during use and release the small white ball inside the cube, posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 9,300.

title: E-Bikes Recalled Due to Fire, Explosion and Burn Hazards; Distributed by Ancheer
summary: The lithium-ion batteries can ignite, explode or spark, posing fire, explosion and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 22,000.

title: Newair Recalls Magic Chef Air Fryers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The air fryer can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 11,750.

title: U.P. Fashion Recalls Children's Rings Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban
summary: The metal base of the ring contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 1,800.

title: U-Line Recalls Outdoor Freezers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The outdoor freezers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 90.

title: Amazon Recalls Amazon Basics Desk Chairs Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The chairs' leg base can break, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 11,400.

title: Bike USA Recalls Punisher Cycling Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability and impact attenuation requirements of the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 3,400.

title: Brother Recalls Power Adapters Sold with AirSure DF-2 Dynamic Filtration Tabletop Air Purifiers Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The Meic AC power adapter casing can break while the adapter is being plugged into or removed from an electrical outlet, exposing its metal prongs, posing electrical shock and electrocution hazards. Units: About 16,300.

title: Goalsetter Recalls Wall-Mounted Basketball Goals Due to Serious Impact Injury Hazard and Risk of Death; One Fatality Reported
summary: The basketball goal can detach from the wall and fall to the ground posing a serious impact injury hazard and risk of death. Units: About 18,000.

title: Johnson Health Tech Trading Recalls Horizon Fitness Treadmills Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The treadmills can unexpectedly accelerate, change speed, or stop without user input, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 192,000 (In addition, about 7,000 sold in Canada).

title: LG Energy Solution Michigan Recalls Home Energy Storage Batteries Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The home solar panel batteries can overheat, posing a risk of fire and emission of harmful smoke. Units: About 11,500.

title: Radio Flyer Recalls Cyberquad for Kids, Due to Violations of Federal Safety Standard for All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) and Risk of Injury; Sold Exclusively Online by Tesla
summary: The Cyberquad fails to comply with the federal mandatory safety standard requirements for youth ATVs, including mechanical suspension and maximum tire pressure. Additionally, the Cyberquad lacks a CPSC-approved ATV action plan, which is required to manufacture, import, sell, or distribute ATVs. Unit

summary: The recalled products may contain bacteria, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa, an environmental organism found widely in soil and water.
